spec_match.rationale: Visualizes and quantifies the exact mathematical flaw in scroll-snap-type: both (generating N² - N synthetic cross-axis snap intersections for N staggered elements) that scroll-snap-type: pair eliminates.

interactive.rationale: Users can vary element count N (2..6), switch 2D gallery topologies (diagonal, anti-diagonal, staggered wave), and click any release coordinate on the 2D SVG plot to compare both vs pair vectors.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index promise of an interactive 2D snap-grid geometry visualizer plotting real element coordinates against N² - N phantom cross-axis intersections.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers N=2 through N=6 (up to 30 phantom intersections) and highlights off-diagonal release coordinates where independent axis distance diverges maximally from 2D Euclidean distance.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/5124378896498688, CSS Scroll Snap Module Level 1, and the explainer.

conformance.rationale: Probes CSS.supports('scroll-snap-type', 'pair mandatory') and contrasts independent axis distance minimization against 2D paired distance minimization.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified slider, topology selector, preset buttons, and SVG coordinate clicking with zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry assertion for the CSS.supports probe and updates the comparison table and aria-live readout on every interaction.

design_system.rationale: Uses only CSS variables from /public/styles.css for HTML and SVG strokes/fills, with zero raw hex or rgba colors.

accessibility.rationale: SVG has role=img and aria-label, preset buttons provide keyboard access to off-diagonal release points, and all outcomes are rendered in a semantic comparison table and aria-live output.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Responsive SVG viewBox and wrapping controls fit cleanly within 360px mobile and 1280px desktop viewports.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure 2D scroll snap targets align predictably and expose state programmatically.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Modeled the exact candidate selection matrix for both vs pair and exposed it in a live comparison table.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide button controls so pointer-based spatial interactions have keyboard equivalents.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Included 44px preset buttons for off-diagonal release coordinates alongside SVG pointer clicks.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide text alternatives for interactive SVG diagrams.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added role=img and aria-label on the SVG plus a 5-row comparison table and aria-live readout.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Ensure range and select inputs have explicit labels and 44px minimum height.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped the range slider and topology select in visible <label> containers with min-height: 44px.

summary: Interactive 2D snap-grid geometry visualizer showing how N staggered elements generate N² - N phantom intersections under scroll-snap-type: both vs N real targets under scroll-snap-type: pair.
